# ViraStack Start — Next.js Edition (i18n)

> Next.js 16 + React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 boilerplate with **next-intl** multi-language routing (`en`, `tr`). Feature-based architecture, agent-ready DX. Auth and database/ORM are intentionally omitted — bring the solution that fits your project.

Built on the App Router with a `[locale]` segment, Server/Client Components, streaming, and the Metadata API. UI primitives use **Base UI** styled with Tailwind CSS 4. State triad: TanStack Query, Zustand, `nuqs`. Forms: React Hook Form + Zod. The home route renders a deletable `features/home` start page and `/users` renders a deletable `features/users` demo; both follow the canonical ViraStack feature tree. **ViraStack AI** ships on scaffold.

- Tech stack: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript 6 (strict + `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`), Node.js `>=22.13.0`
- i18n: `next-intl` — locales `en` (default) and `tr`; messages in `src/messages/*.json`; routing in `src/i18n/`; message types registered in `src/types/next-intl.d.ts`
- URLs: English at `/` and `/users`, Turkish at `/tr` and `/tr/users`; `/en` redirects to `/`; no redirects by cookie or browser language (`localeDetection: false`)
- UI: Base UI, Sonner, Lucide React, `next-themes`, `class-variance-authority`
- Data & state: TanStack Query 5, Zustand, `nuqs`
- Forms: React Hook Form + Zod (+ `@hookform/resolvers`)
- Testing: Vitest, React Testing Library, user-event, jest-dom, MSW (`src/test/`)
- API: Native `fetch` wrapper in `src/lib/api.ts` (`ApiError` with `message`, `status`, `data`)
- Env: Zod schema in `src/env.ts`
- Tooling: ESLint 10, Prettier 3, Husky, Knip, Commitlint, Changesets, `@next/bundle-analyzer`
- ViraStack AI: `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/rules/virastack/`, `.cursor/rules/virastack/`, `.virastack/ai.json`
- Not included by default: Auth, DB/ORM, CSP

## Key Files & Entry Points
- [`src/app/layout.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/app/layout.tsx): Root shell
- [`src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/app/%5Blocale%5D/layout.tsx): Locale layout + next-intl provider
- [`src/app/[locale]/page.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/app/%5Blocale%5D/page.tsx): Home → `<HomePage />`
- [`src/app/[locale]/users/page.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/app/%5Blocale%5D/users/page.tsx): Demo route with server prefetch
- [`src/app/[locale]/users/loading.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/app/%5Blocale%5D/users/loading.tsx): Route skeleton
- [`src/app/[locale]/error.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/app/%5Blocale%5D/error.tsx): Route error boundary
- [`src/app/[locale]/not-found.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/app/%5Blocale%5D/not-found.tsx): 404
- [`src/app/global-error.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/app/global-error.tsx): Root error boundary
- [`src/app/sitemap.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/app/sitemap.ts): Sitemap with both languages
- [`src/config/seo.config.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/config/seo.config.ts): Default metadata and `hreflang` alternates
- [`src/i18n/routing.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/i18n/routing.ts): Locales, defaultLocale, no locale detection
- [`src/i18n/request.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/i18n/request.ts): next-intl request config
- [`src/messages/en.json`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/messages/en.json): English messages
- [`src/messages/tr.json`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/messages/tr.json): Turkish messages
- [`src/components/shared/LanguageSwitcher.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/components/shared/LanguageSwitcher.tsx): Locale switcher
- [`src/env.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/env.ts): Zod env schema
- [`src/config/site.config.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/config/site.config.ts): Site config
- [`src/lib/api.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/lib/api.ts): Fetch wrapper + `ApiError`
- [`src/providers/Providers.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/providers/Providers.tsx): Theme, Query, Nuqs, Toaster
- [`src/proxy.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/proxy.ts): Next.js 16 network boundary (next-intl locale routing)
- [`next.config.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/next.config.ts): Next config + next-intl plugin

## Start Page and Users Demo (delete when building)
The home page composes `HomePage`; `/users` composes `UsersPage` and `UsersDirectory`. Their text lives in the `Home` and `Users` namespaces of `src/messages/*.json`.

- [`src/features/home/components/HomePage.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/features/home/components/HomePage.tsx): Start page
- [`src/features/home/constants/home.constants.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/features/home/constants/home.constants.ts): Stack list data and links
- [`src/features/home/helpers/parse-version.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/features/home/helpers/parse-version.ts): Reads stack versions from package.json ranges
- [`src/features/users/components/UsersDirectory.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/features/users/components/UsersDirectory.tsx): List, search, pagination and states
- [`src/features/users/components/AddUserForm.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/features/users/components/AddUserForm.tsx): RHF + Zod form
- [`src/features/users/api/get-users.api.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/features/users/api/get-users.api.ts): DummyJSON list and search
- [`src/features/users/api/add-user.api.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/features/users/api/add-user.api.ts): DummyJSON add (does not save)
- [`src/features/users/hooks/use-users-params.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/features/users/hooks/use-users-params.ts): `nuqs` page and search
- [`src/features/users/stores/favorites.store.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/features/users/stores/favorites.store.ts): Zustand favorites
- [`src/features/users/schemas/user.schema.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/nextjs/src/features/users/schemas/user.schema.ts): Zod schemas

To remove the demo: delete `src/features/users` and `src/app/[locale]/users`, remove `/users` from `src/app/sitemap.ts` and the `Users` messages, then update `src/features/home`. To remove the start page: also delete `src/features/home` and its `Home` messages, and replace `src/app/[locale]/page.tsx`.

## Architecture for agents
- Feature-based: work under `src/features/[feature]/` — no cross-feature imports
- Import from the defining file with the single `@/*` alias. There are no barrel files.
- Never hardcode UI strings — use `useTranslations` / message JSON; `src/i18n/messages.test.ts` fails when locales have different keys
- Brand name `ViraStack` stays untranslated
- Search for `FIXME:` after scaffold

## ViraStack AI
- Install or refresh: `npx @virastack/ai init`
- Package: [`@virastack/ai`](https://github.com/virastack/ai)
